culture.title: Bo-Kaap Museum and Wale Street Colours
culture.description: Learn the Cape Malay story inside an 18th century house, then wander the brightly painted cobbled streets outside.
culture.bonus: Photograph a door in every colour of the rainbow.

culture.title: Baxter Theatre Night
culture.description: Catch new South African drama or comedy at the landmark theatre complex beneath the university in Rondebosch.
culture.bonus: Pick the show by its poster alone without reading any reviews.

culture.title: Castle of Good Hope
culture.description: Explore the star-shaped fort built in the 1660s, the oldest surviving colonial building in South Africa.
culture.bonus: Walk the full ramparts and find the bell tower entrance.

culture.title: District Six Museum
culture.description: Walk across a floor map of a neighbourhood erased by apartheid and read the names former residents wrote on it.
culture.bonus: Find a street name on the floor map and then go stand on that street today.

culture.title: Robben Island Museum Ferry Tour
culture.description: Cross Table Bay to the island prison where Nelson Mandela spent 18 years and hear its story from a former political prisoner.
culture.bonus: Ask your guide one question about life on the island that is not in the brochure.

culture.title: Norval Foundation Sculpture Garden
culture.description: See modern South African art in airy galleries, then walk a sculpture garden that runs into a wetland below the mountains.
culture.bonus: Sketch one sculpture in under two minutes, no matter how bad it looks.

culture.title: Zeitz MOCAA at the Silo District
culture.description: Explore contemporary African art inside a former grain silo carved into a cathedral of light.
culture.bonus: Pick the one artwork you would hang at home and explain why to someone.

culture.title: Guga S'Thebe Arts and Culture Centre in Langa
culture.description: Visit the mosaic-covered community arts centre in Cape Town's oldest township and meet the potters and artists at work.
culture.bonus: Buy one handmade piece directly from the artist who made it.

social.title: Stormers Rugby at DHL Stadium
social.description: Pull on blue and white and roar for the Stormers in a World Cup stadium with Signal Hill as the backdrop.
social.bonus: Learn one Stormers chant before kickoff and lead it at least once.

social.title: The Gin Bar Hidden Courtyard on Wale Street
social.description: Walk through a chocolate café into a secret courtyard bar pouring South African craft gin cocktails.
social.bonus: Order the gin cocktail with the strangest botanical and guess every ingredient.

social.title: Green Point Parkrun
social.description: Join hundreds of locals for a free, timed 5km Saturday run past the stadium and along the Atlantic seafront.
social.bonus: High five three strangers at the finish and invite one to coffee.

social.title: Devil's Peak Brewing Taproom Session
social.description: Drink limited-release craft beers straight from the brewery that helped start Cape Town's craft beer boom.
social.bonus: Order a tasting flight and rank the beers blind.

social.title: Café Caprice Sundowners in Camps Bay
social.description: Grab a table on Victoria Road for cocktails as the sun sets behind the palms and the DJ turns it up.
social.bonus: Toast the exact moment the sun touches the horizon.

social.title: Mama Africa Marimba Night on Long Street
social.description: Eat game meat and dance to a live marimba band at a Long Street restaurant that has been a party since the 1990s.
social.bonus: Order the dish with the animal you have never tried.

social.title: Asoka Cocktails on Kloof Street
social.description: Order cocktails and small plates in a candlelit courtyard built around an olive tree, then stay for the DJ.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender to make you something off menu based on your favourite fruit.

social.title: Spier Wine Farm Tasting and Picnic
social.description: Taste wines beside the dam at a 1692 Stellenbosch farm and stretch out with a picnic under the oaks.
social.bonus: Try the chocolate and wine pairing and vote on the best match.

social.title: Banana Jam Cafe Craft Beer Night
social.description: Work through 30 taps and Caribbean food at the Kenilworth brewpub that brought craft beer to Cape Town.
social.bonus: Order the beer with the weirdest name on the board without reading the description.

social.title: Kloof Street House Garden Dinner
social.description: Dine under fairy lights in the garden of a quirky Victorian house packed with chandeliers and eclectic art.
social.bonus: Order a cocktail you have never heard of and share a sip around the table.

social.title: Franschhoek Wine Tram Day
social.description: Hop on and off a vintage-style tram through the Franschhoek valley, stopping at wine estates for tastings and lunch.
social.bonus: Let a different friend choose the next estate at every stop.

social.title: Groot Constantia Wine Tasting
social.description: Taste wines at South Africa's oldest wine estate, founded in 1685, among Cape Dutch gables and old oaks.
social.bonus: Each person picks a favourite and defends it in one sentence.

8ball.title: Greenmarket Square Wildcard Dare
8ball.description: Head to the cobbled market square in the heart of the CBD and let the traders decide what your afternoon becomes.
8ball.bonus: Ask a trader to pick a gift for someone in your life for under R100, buy whatever they choose and deliver it today.

8ball.title: Long Street Coin Flip Night
8ball.description: Start at the top of Long Street and let a coin decide every turn, door and order until the night ends.
8ball.bonus: Flip at every block, heads means go inside the nearest open spot, tails means talk to the next person you pass.

adventure.title: Kayak Cape Town Penguin Paddle
adventure.description: Paddle a double kayak from Simon's Town past the naval harbour to see the Boulders penguins from the water.
adventure.bonus: Name the first penguin you see and give it a backstory before you turn back.

adventure.title: Hi5 Paragliding Tandem Flight Off Signal Hill
adventure.description: Run off Signal Hill strapped to a pilot and glide over Sea Point and the Atlantic before landing on the promenade.
adventure.bonus: Shout the name of one person you are grateful for the moment your feet leave the ground.

adventure.title: Platteklip Gorge Climb Up Table Mountain
adventure.description: Earn the view by climbing the steep, direct gorge route to the top of Table Mountain instead of taking the cable car.
adventure.bonus: Count every switchback on the way up and announce the total at the summit.

adventure.title: Kasteelspoort Hike Up Table Mountain
adventure.description: Climb the back of Table Mountain from Camps Bay to the famous diving board rock above the Twelve Apostles.
adventure.bonus: Pose on the diving board rock, safely seated, and send the photo to someone who has never been to Cape Town.

adventure.title: Abseil Africa Table Mountain Abseil
adventure.description: Lean back over the edge near the upper cable station and drop 112 metres down the face of Table Mountain.
adventure.bonus: Stop halfway down, let go of the view for a second and wave at the cable car going past.

adventure.title: Southern Right Charters Whale Watching in Hermanus
adventure.description: Board a catamaran out of Hermanus New Harbour and get close to southern right whales breaching in Walker Bay.
adventure.bonus: Learn the difference between a breach and a lobtail from the guide and call out the next one you see.

adventure.title: Downhill Adventures Sandboarding at Atlantis Dunes
adventure.description: Strap into a sandboard and carve down towering white dunes outside the city with the operator that pioneered the sport here.
adventure.bonus: Try one run lying down on your stomach and race your crew to the bottom.

adventure.title: Jonkershoek Nature Reserve Waterfall Hike
adventure.description: Trade the city for a quiet valley outside Stellenbosch and hike to waterfalls between steep mountain walls.
adventure.bonus: Stand under the spray of the falls for a full ten seconds.

adventure.title: Animal Ocean Seal Snorkel at Duiker Island
adventure.description: Slip into the cold Atlantic off Hout Bay and float among hundreds of playful Cape fur seals.
adventure.bonus: Let a seal pup come to you without reaching out and count how close it gets.

adventure.title: Lion's Head Sunrise Hike
adventure.description: Scramble the chains and ladders of Lion's Head in the dark and watch the sun light up the whole city from the summit.
adventure.bonus: Pack a flask of coffee and share a cup with someone you meet at the top.

adventure.title: Table Mountain Aerial Cableway Ride
adventure.description: Ride the rotating cable car to the flat top of Table Mountain and wander the summit trails above the clouds.
adventure.bonus: Find the spot on top where you can see both Robben Island and Cape Point and take a photo of each.

adventure.title: Elephant's Eye Cave Hike in Silvermine
adventure.description: Hike through fynbos above Tokai to a big cave in the mountainside with views over the Constantia valley.
adventure.bonus: Sit in the cave for five quiet minutes and spot your home neighbourhood from up there.

adventure.title: Skeleton Gorge Hike to Maclear's Beacon
adventure.description: Climb wooden ladders up a forested ravine from Kirstenbosch to the highest point on Table Mountain.
adventure.bonus: Dip your hands in the Hely-Hutchinson reservoir and toast the climb with whatever snack you packed.

adventure.title: Chapman's Peak Drive Sunset Cruise
adventure.description: Wind along one of the world's great coastal roads between Hout Bay and Noordhoek as the sun drops into the ocean.
adventure.bonus: Pull over at a lookout and record a 10 second video of the waves with no talking.

adventure.title: Cape Point Lighthouse Walk
adventure.description: Drive to the tip of the Cape Peninsula and hike up to the old lighthouse where two oceans meet below the cliffs.
adventure.bonus: Skip the funicular and walk both ways, then spot a baboon or an eland from a safe distance.

foodie.title: Neighbourgoods Market at the Old Biscuit Mill
foodie.description: Graze your way through a Saturday food market in a converted Woodstock biscuit factory.
foodie.bonus: Buy one thing from a stall you would normally walk past.

foodie.title: La Colombe Tasting Menu at Silvermist
foodie.description: Book a seat at one of the world's top-ranked restaurants, perched on a mountain wine estate above Constantia.
foodie.bonus: Ask the server which course the chef is proudest of and save that one for last.

foodie.title: Biesmiellah Cape Malay Lunch in Bo-Kaap
foodie.description: Eat bobotie, bredie and chilli bites at a family-run Cape Malay institution on the edge of the colourful Bo-Kaap.
foodie.bonus: Order a dish you cannot pronounce and ask the staff how to say it.

foodie.title: Kalky's Fish and Chips at Kalk Bay Harbour
foodie.description: Queue with locals for hake and chips at a no-frills harbour shack while fishing boats unload beside you.
foodie.bonus: Order snoek instead of hake and eat it with your hands.

foodie.title: Giovanni's Deliworld Salmon Bagel
foodie.description: Grab an espresso and the famous salmon bagel at a Green Point deli that has fed the neighbourhood since 1989.
foodie.bonus: Ask for extra pickled onions and eat it on a bench at Green Point Park.

foodie.title: Bay Harbour Market Friday Night in Hout Bay
foodie.description: Eat your way through food stalls and live music inside an old fish factory on the Hout Bay harbour.
foodie.bonus: Dance to at least one song by the live band, even if nobody else is.

foodie.title: The Codfather Fish Counter in Camps Bay
foodie.description: Skip the menu, point at the fish you want on the ice counter and have it cooked to order with ocean views.
foodie.bonus: Pick one fish species you have never eaten and have it prepared the chef's way.

foodie.title: Truth Coffee Roasting Steampunk Brew
foodie.description: Sip a flat white among copper pipes and a giant vintage roaster in the café once voted the best coffee shop in the world.
foodie.bonus: Order a coffee style you have never tried and rate it out of ten.

foodie.title: Mariner's Wharf Fish and Chips in Hout Bay
foodie.description: Eat hake and chips out of paper at South Africa's original harbourfront fish market in Hout Bay.
foodie.bonus: Feed nothing to the seals but find one and give it a name.

foodie.title: Babylonstoren Garden Tour and Babel Lunch
foodie.description: Walk a vast edible garden on a historic Cape Dutch farm, then eat what was picked that morning in a converted cow shed.
foodie.bonus: Taste one herb or fruit straight from the garden that you have never eaten before.

foodie.title: Eastern Food Bazaar Curry and Naan
foodie.description: Dive into a buzzing halaal food hall in the CBD for cheap curries, kebabs and a garlic naan the size of your plate.
foodie.bonus: Order from a different stall than everyone else in your group and swap bites.

foodie.title: Oranjezicht City Farm Market Saturday Breakfast
foodie.description: Eat breakfast from local growers and bakers at a farmers market in a timber barn looking over Table Bay.
foodie.bonus: Buy one vegetable you have never cooked and make something with it that night.

chill.title: Hermanus Cliff Path Whale Spotting
chill.description: Walk the coastal cliff path in Hermanus where southern right whales come close enough to hear them blow.
chill.bonus: Count the whales you see and treat yourself to one scoop of ice cream per whale.

chill.title: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden Stroll
chill.description: Wander lawns, proteas and the treetop Boomslang walkway at the foot of Table Mountain's eastern slopes.
chill.bonus: Find a king protea in bloom and take a photo of it with the mountain behind.

chill.title: Company's Garden Afternoon Wander
chill.description: Slow down in the city's oldest garden, planted in the 1650s, among ancient trees, rose beds and curious squirrels.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest pear tree in the garden and read its plaque.

chill.title: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concert
chill.description: Spread a picnic blanket on the garden lawns and watch a top South African act play as the sun sets behind the mountain.
chill.bonus: Bring a picnic where every item is from a different local shop.

chill.title: Sea Point Promenade Sunset Walk
chill.description: Join joggers, dog walkers and ice cream eaters on the seafront promenade as the sky turns orange.
chill.bonus: Find the big red ring sculpture and frame the sunset through it.

chill.title: Clifton 4th Beach Afternoon
chill.description: Claim a patch of white sand in a wind-sheltered cove and brave the icy Atlantic between naps.
chill.bonus: Run into the water up to your shoulders and stay for a count of twenty.

chill.title: The Galileo Open Air Cinema at Kirstenbosch
chill.description: Watch a classic film on a big screen under the stars in the botanical garden, picnic and blanket included.
chill.bonus: Dress up as a character from the film you are watching.

chill.title: St James Tidal Pool and Beach Huts
chill.description: Swim in a sheltered tidal pool beside the famous candy-striped Victorian beach huts on False Bay.
chill.bonus: Take a photo in front of every colour of beach hut.

chill.title: Boulders Beach Penguin Colony
chill.description: Walk the boardwalks above a granite-boulder beach where thousands of African penguins nest and waddle.
chill.bonus: Watch one penguin for five full minutes and narrate its day like a nature documentary.

chill.title: Signal Hill Sunset Picnic
chill.description: Drive up Signal Hill with a blanket and snacks to watch the sun sink behind the Atlantic and the city lights come on.
chill.bonus: Stay until you can count ten ships' lights out in Table Bay.
